# Fonts

Embedded into the game file by `build.mjs` (no downloads at play time).

| File | Font | License |
|---|---|---|
| `inter-latin-*.woff2` | Inter, by Rasmus Andersson | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `im-fell-english-sc-latin-400-normal.woff2` | IM FELL English SC, by Igino Marini | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `special-elite-latin-400-normal.woff2` | Special Elite, by Astigmatic | Apache License 2.0 |

Taken from the Fontsource packages (`@fontsource/inter`, `@fontsource/im-fell-english-sc`, `@fontsource/special-elite`, version 5.3.0).
